# assignmentB2AislinnDressler

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of assignmentB2AislinnDressler is to provide a package for a function to count missing values (count_all_missing_by_group).The function counts the amount of missing data in each column of a dataset and outputs a tibble with the amount of missing data in each column group.

## Installation

You can install the development version of assignmentB2AislinnDressler from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("UBC-STAT545-F2026/assignmentB2AislinnDressler")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

```{r example}
library(assignmentB2AislinnDressler)
count_all_missing_by_group(airquality, Month)
```
